title: Optimized Day Counter
description: Want to know what day it is and what hour it is in your minecraft world? Well this mod does exactly that.
body:
# Optimized Day Counter

**Optimized Day Counter** is a lightweight, client-side HUD mod that shows the current in-game day and optional 12‑hour clock, letting you track your world's progress at a glance.

[![Available for Fabric](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/fabric_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/optimizeddaycounter/versions?l=fabric)
[![Available for Forge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/forge_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/optimizeddaycounter/versions?l=forge)
[![Available for NeoForge](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/supported/neoforge_vector.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/optimizeddaycounter/versions?l=neoforge)
[![Donate](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@intergrav/devins-badges@3/assets/cozy/donate/kofi-singular_vector.svg)](https://ko-fi.com/U2P522M1IW)

## 🎬 How It Works

The mod adds a small, unobtrusive HUD element that displays the current world day and, optionally, the time of day in a 12‑hour format. It updates automatically as the world progresses and can be fully customized through a config file.

![Optimized Day Counter Demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/ModItamio/main/assets/screenshots/optimizeddaycounter/showing-the-day-counter.gif)

![Time Counter cover image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/day-counter/main/.modcompiler-art/description-image.webp)

![Day 25](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/614e76cb1562de86b5b50def0eb73363ddec4cac.png)

## ✨ Features

- **Day Number Display** — Shows “Day X” where X is the current day number based on world time.
- **Optional 12‑Hour Clock** — Displays the current time of day with AM/PM (e.g., “Day 3 | 2 PM” or “Day 3 | 2:30 PM”).
- **Configurable Anchor Position** — Choose from 6 positions: `top_left`, `top_right`, `bottom_left`, `bottom_right`, `center_top`, `center_bottom`.
- **Pixel‑Perfect Offsets** — Fine‑tune the HUD placement with `offset_x` and `offset_y` from the selected anchor.
- **Three Display Modes** — Choose between days only, days + hour, or days + hour + minute.
- **Hot‑Reload Config** — Edit the config file while the game is running; changes appear after a short delay (config checks every 500ms).
- **Info Card** — Prints a stylish author and contributor info card on launch.

## 📦 Installation

1. Install the mod loader of your choice ([Fabric](https://fabricmc.net/use/), [Forge](https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/), or [NeoForge](https://neoforged.net/)).
2. Download `optimizeddaycounter-<version>.jar` and place it into your `.minecraft/mods` folder.
3. Launch the game — the mod will create the config file on first run.

This mod is **client‑side only** and does not need to be installed on the server.

## 🧩 Compatibility

| 1.12.2    | Forge          | ✅ Supported  | Latest  |

**Required dependencies:** None.  
**Known incompatibilities:** None known.  
**Works alongside:** Any other client‑side mods, including Sodium, Iris, and OptiFine.

## ❓ FAQ

**Does this need to be installed on the server?**  
No. The mod is purely client‑side and reads directly from the local world state. You can safely use it on any server.

**How do I configure the HUD?**  
Open `./config/optimizeddaycounter.txt` (created automatically on first launch). Edit the settings, save the file, and the mod will reload the config within a few seconds.

**Can I move the HUD to a different corner?**  
Yes! Set `anchor` to one of: `top_left`, `top_right`, `bottom_left`, `bottom_right`, `center_top`, or `center_bottom`. Adjust `offset_x` and `offset_y` to fine‑tune the position.

**Does this mod add any commands, items, or blocks?**  
No. It’s a simple HUD overlay with no extra mechanics to learn.

**I found a bug, where do I report it?**  
Please report issues on the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/Sekai0NI0itamio/ModItamio/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3Aoptimizeddaycounter). Include your Minecraft version, mod loader, and a log file.
